01 Profile

Third-year student of Geospatial Systems and Technologies at Sofia University. I turn open spatial data into atlases, research posters and web maps, from cleaning the data to laying out the final sheet. Founder and chair of GIS Club SU. Open to internships in GIS and remote sensing.

02 Selected projects

  • V4+2 Map Atlas 2026

    A 36-sheet A3 atlas for the spatial development strategy of six Central and Eastern European countries, redrawn from current open data. One script per sheet on a shared style library, with a conflict analysis of planned infrastructure against Natura 2000. Python · GeoPandas · Rasterio · Matplotlib

  • Sofia — access to basic services 2026

    Walking access to six services for 310 neighbourhoods: OpenStreetMap facilities and the census population grid on a pedestrian network, a composite index and LISA hotspots. Python · OSMnx · PySAL · Mapbox GL JS

  • Ridges and viewpoints 2026

    An inverted-DEM method that traces ridgelines with flow accumulation, then ranks viewpoints by what each sees within 10 km. WhiteboxTools · GDAL · QGIS · Typst

  • Bulgaria’s warming stripes 2026

    Climate stripes for every province, 1961–2025, from 36 station records, with gaps estimated from neighbouring stations and documented on the poster. Python

  • Kyustendil Species Atlas 2026

    Interactive atlas of 185 Red Book taxa and 23 invasive plants on the UTM 10 × 10 km grid, joined to seven Natura 2000 sites.

  • Venerable trees of Bulgaria 2026

    Bilingual interactive map of 1,372 protected centuries-old trees from the national register. Mapbox GL JS · Python

All projects, with maps: bbaid.github.io
